axis: esm2_t33_650M_aspect_prediction: health check for the 3-way aspect (C/F/P) classifier a real sequential-cascade first stage would need
note: trial-078 showed a decisive win from feeding the GROUND-TRUTH aspect into the depth-1 classifier, but that's an oracle upper bound - a real cascade needs an actual aspect predictor. Per user direction, before committing a full data/epoch budget to that predictor, this trial takes trial-071b (the original health-check trial for this model class: 3 epochs, 450 train (resampled)/100 val, batch_size=16, unfreeze_last_n=27, learning_rate=2e-5, weight_decay=0.2, output_dropout=0.2, bf16, --no-gradient-checkpointing) as the base and adapts it two ways: (1) 4 epochs instead of 3, with --max-train-samples reduced to 338 (450*3/4=337.5, rounded up) to hold the TOTAL training-examples budget constant (338*4=1352 vs the original 450*3=1350) while spreading it across more, smaller resampled draws - per the discussion this trial follows from, more epochs with less data per epoch gives a better health signal in this codebase specifically, because the validation set is fixed (not resampled) every epoch while the training draw is fresh each time (build_train_dataloader reseeds by args.seed+epoch), so more epochs means more independent (train_loss, val_loss) trend observations against the same held-out set rather than relying on fewer, noisier ones; (2) --dataset-repo-id kelmoir/cafa6-aspect (generate_dataset_aspect.py) instead of the depth-1/coarse datasets - label space is just the 3 GO namespace roots (molecular_function/cellular_component/biological_process), a 3-way multi-hot (most proteins have more than one aspect simultaneously - verified: only ~29% of proteins have exactly one, 43.7% have all three). --batch-size 8 --grad-accum-steps 2 (effective batch 16, matching trial-071b's own effective batch size) replaces trial-071b's flat batch_size=16, carrying forward the standing default adopted after trial-076/077/078's OOM lessons rather than reverting to the now-suspect original value. --use-aspect-input NOT set (nonsensical here - aspects are the prediction target this time, not an auxiliary input). --checkpoint-mode final and --push-to-hub NOT set, matching trial-071b's own convention for a calibration trial (purpose is health, not promotion or timing).
